<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/v1/spaces/{space_id}/objects/batch"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Fetches multiple objects by their IDs within the specified space in a single request. Objects that cannot be found are represented by a "null" entry in the response, preserving the order of the requested IDs. This avoids the need to issue one request per object when a client operates on a known set of objects (e.g. a list of tasks or commitments).
